entries.cause: Issue 959 stage 1, commit d34eee69. The campaign compatibility version moves from 5.3.0 to 5.4.0 because CompiledDesignVersion gains optional hullLengthMm and hullBeamMm. The compatibility version is part of the unified snapshot hash, so the checkpoint snapshot hash of this month moves, and the hashes derived from it move with it: the expectedSnapshotHash of a command, the command ledger entry hashes, and the engine digest and replay verification hash of the malta replay. Proof: with only the stamp reverted to 5.3.0 at the same commit, the 17 replays verify at each month in two fresh processes, so the hull fields and the code leak into no hash. Event ledgers, ledger entry counts and event hashes are identical old versus new. Production pack designs are template designs without hull data and stay absent.
entries.migrationAssessment: A 5.3.0 save is refused and never migrated, per BW-PER-001. The optional hull fields are absent on the existing designs, so no migration and no fabricated data is needed and no stored outcome moves. The class is EXPECTED_GAMEPLAY_CHANGE only because SERIALIZATION_ONLY rejects a moved compatibility version and RULESET_VERSION_CHANGE requires a moved ruleset version. The move is a version stamp and not a gameplay result.

Proof: with only the stamp reverted to 5.3.0 at the same commit, the 17 replays verify at each month in two fresh processes, so the hull fields and the code leak into no hash. Event ledgers, ledger entry counts and event hashes are identical old versus new. Production pack designs are template designs without hull data and stay absent.
entries.migrationAssessment: A 5.3.0 save is refused and never migrated, per BW-PER-001. The optional hull fields are absent on the existing designs, so no migration and no fabricated data is needed and no stored outcome moves. The class is EXPECTED_GAMEPLAY_CHANGE only because SERIALIZATION_ONLY rejects a moved compatibility version and RULESET_VERSION_CHANGE requires a moved ruleset version. The move is a version stamp and not a gameplay result.

Proof: with only the stamp reverted to 5.3.0 at the same commit, the 17 replays verify at each month in two fresh processes, so the hull fields and the code leak into no hash. Event ledgers, ledger entry counts and event hashes are identical old versus new. Production pack designs are template designs without hull data and stay absent.
entries.migrationAssessment: A 5.3.0 save is refused and never migrated, per BW-PER-001. The optional hull fields are absent on the existing designs, so no migration and no fabricated data is needed and no stored outcome moves. The class is EXPECTED_GAMEPLAY_CHANGE only because SERIALIZATION_ONLY rejects a moved compatibility version and RULESET_VERSION_CHANGE requires a moved ruleset version. The move is a version stamp and not a gameplay result.

Proof: with only the stamp reverted to 5.3.0 at the same commit, the 17 replays verify at each month in two fresh processes, so the hull fields and the code leak into no hash. Event ledgers, ledger entry counts and event hashes are identical old versus new. Production pack designs are template designs without hull data and stay absent.
entries.migrationAssessment: A 5.3.0 save is refused and never migrated, per BW-PER-001. The optional hull fields are absent on the existing designs, so no migration and no fabricated data is needed and no stored outcome moves. The class is EXPECTED_GAMEPLAY_CHANGE only because SERIALIZATION_ONLY rejects a moved compatibility version and RULESET_VERSION_CHANGE requires a moved ruleset version. The move is a version stamp and not a gameplay result.

Proof: with only the stamp reverted to 5.3.0 at the same commit, the 17 replays verify at each month in two fresh processes, so the hull fields and the code leak into no hash. Event ledgers, ledger entry counts and event hashes are identical old versus new. Production pack designs are template designs without hull data and stay absent.
entries.migrationAssessment: A 5.3.0 save is refused and never migrated, per BW-PER-001. The optional hull fields are absent on the existing designs, so no migration and no fabricated data is needed and no stored outcome moves. The class is EXPECTED_GAMEPLAY_CHANGE only because SERIALIZATION_ONLY rejects a moved compatibility version and RULESET_VERSION_CHANGE requires a moved ruleset version. The move is a version stamp and not a gameplay result.
